purpose: DIAGNOSTIC: Measures label alignment between static Phase 6 benchmark labels and actual LLM responses generated in Phase 7. This is NOT an independent detector benchmark.

label_shift.interpretation: 190 of 375 prompts labeled 'hallucinated' (50.67%) were answered factually correctly by the live LLM (Qwen2.5-Coder:1.5b via Ollama). The static benchmark label is invalid for those responses.

circular_evaluation_disclosure: CIRCULAR EVALUATION: Dataset B response_ground_truth was assigned using P1 NLI score thresholds (factual < 0.35, hallucinated ≥ 0.55). Evaluating P1 against this label produces AUROC ≈ 1.0 — a mathematical artifact because P1's own scores defined the labels. This MUST NOT be reported as evidence of detector quality.
primary_scientific_finding: 50.7% of hallucination-labeled benchmark prompts were answered factually by the live LLM. Static benchmark labels cannot serve as ground truth for newly generated responses.
